lines.text: Your best deploy playbook lives in a folder on one laptop.
Every other agent has never heard of it. They guess the steps, and every guess is a little different.
You could copy the folder around by hand, but each copy drifts the moment someone edits it.
In Agent R Q, skills do not live on a machine. They live in the workspace, as one shared library.
When an agent learns something worth repeating, it saves it as a skill, and the workspace stores it.
Any agent can search the library over M C P, and find the skill it needs by name.
It loads the skill only when it needs it, so the playbook is always the current one.
Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, all of them get the same playbook, on any machine.
Then an agent notices a missing step. Staging needs the VPN first, so it updates the skill.
The skill becomes version eight, and it is live for every agent in the workspace at once.
No copying files around, ever. Fix a step once, and every agent gets the update.
Where do your agents keep their playbooks today? Tell us in the comments, and try it at Agent R Q dot com.
